question: Is the reported Testbox and focused-test validation sufficient for this protected maintainer refactor, or should the PR include an inspectable redacted after-fix transcript before merge?
rationale: The patch has no discrete code defect, but the external-PR proof gate requires visible after-fix evidence and the protected label requires explicit human handling rather than an automated merge verdict.

options.title: Add direct focused-check evidence
options.body: Attach a redacted terminal transcript or linked artifact showing the focused quality test and max-lines ratchet check passing on the current head.

options.title: Accept the existing validation record
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the reported Testbox evidence if it is independently accessible and sufficient for this test-only cleanup.
